subject: Post-call: Compliance checklist + console cookie/telemetry questions
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@finco.com>, Tom Reed <t.reed@finco.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call: Compliance checklist + console cookie/telemetry questions

Hi Elena / Tom —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and agreed next steps so we have a single place to track: 

1) SOC 2 / compliance status
   - You asked for an overview of our SOC 2 scope and when we expect the next report. Attached is a 1-page summary of our SOC 2 Type II coverage (redwood_soc2_summary.pdf).
   - Short answer: current SOC 2 Type II in-scope items include API/serving runtime, access controls, change management and encryption in transit/at rest. Latest audit completed Q2 2026; full report available under NDA.

2) Privacy / telemetry / cookies (console + docs)
   - High level: our console collects minimal telemetry for UI performance and feature usage (anonymous aggregate metrics by default). We do set a small client-side cookie for session persistence; nothing is sent to third-party analytics by default in private deployments.
   - You asked where this is documented: pointing you to the extract in the attachments and public doc: https://docs.redwood.com/privacy/console-telemetry#cookies (link included in thread metadata).

3) Vendor security questionnaire (initial)
   - Karthik (cc’d) will kick off the formal vendor questionnaire — we can either provide a spreadsheet export or a portal link.

Next actions we agreed on call:
- Diego: Share SOC 2 summary + cookie snippet (attached) and vendor questionnaire intake link (today)
- FinCo: Confirm whether they need a SOC 2 NDA before full report (Elena) and list any extra DPIA / HIPAA items to surface (Tom)
- Karthik: Start the vendor Q intake and assign to security for detailed answers (by Mon)

If that matches your notes, I’ll queue a short follow-up call for the week after Thanksgiving.

Thanks,

Diego Fernandez
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Diego@redwood.com | +1 (408) 555-0163

Attachments: redwood_soc2_summary.pdf, console_cookie_settings_excerpt.txt

From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@finco.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Reed <t.reed@finco.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 16:03:12 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call: Compliance checklist + console cookie/telemetry questions

Thanks Diego — useful summary. A couple clarifying items from our security team: 

- SOC 2: If the full report requires an NDA, please go ahead and send the NDA template so we can expedite. Otherwise a SOC 2 bridge letter would be helpful if the last full report is Q2 2026.

- HIPAA/GDPR: We are processing PHI in one of our workloads; can you confirm whether Redwood has HIPAA attestation / BAA process or whether that would be covered under Private deployment only?

- Telemetry / cookies: our security/QA wants to know whether console telemetry can be fully disabled and whether the cookie is strictly first-party. Also please confirm if any telemetry is logged with IPs or PII.

Please and thanks — I’ll turn this over to security@finco.com if needed.

Best,
Elena
Director, Cloud Platforms | FinCo
elena.morales@finco.com

From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@finco.com>, Tom Reed <t.reed@finco.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 09:02:45 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call: Compliance checklist + console cookie/telemetry questions

Elena —

Quick answers inline and next steps. TL;DR: SOC 2 available w/ NDA, HIPAA handled via Private + BAA evaluation, telemetry can be disabled for Private and is pseudonymous by default for Hosted.

- SOC 2 / NDA: attaching the one-pager above. If you need the full report we can execute our standard NDA (I uploaded a one-page mutual NDA template to: https://forms.securevendor.com/finco-survey?id=FINCO-8942). Please tell me if you prefer an executed DocuSign and I’ll route.

- HIPAA / BAA: We do not have a blanket public BAA for Hosted. For regulated PHI workloads we advise Private deployments (VPC or on-prem) and Redwood Legal will work with you on a BAA. I’ve flagged this to Legal and to Karthik to coordinate.

- Telemetry/cookies:
   * Can telemetry be disabled? Yes — in Private deployments telemetry collection is configurable and can be turned off. For Hosted, we support an opt-out flag for customer accounts but not full removal for platform monitoring unless under an enterprise agreement.
   * Cookies: session cookie is first-party only; no third-party analytics are included by default in Private. Hosted console uses first-party cookies and sends aggregate, pseudonymized metrics (no PII).
   * IP addresses: transient IPs are used for rate-limiting logs but are not stored in analytics buckets by default; we can redact or not capture IPs for a Private deployment if required.

Action items I’m taking now:
- Karthik: please start the vendor questionnaire and pull in Security to answer the deeper architecture questions (I put the intake link in related_links).
- Diego: I’ll share the NDA template and attach the SOC 2 summary (done).
- Marissa: please prep a short blurb on BAA process and timing for FinCo — cc’d.

If it helps, we can run a short workshop with your security team to go through the questionnaire line-by-line.

Cheers,
Diego Fernandez
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: console_cookie_settings_excerpt.txt

From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Internal: FinCo follow-up & who owns what (short)

Folks — quick internal note to capture owners so nothing slips:

- Karthik: own the vendor questionnaire and loop Security (please ask for a Level 2 review on the architecture/PCI/HIPAA items). Target: initial draft answers by EOD Tues.
- Marissa: own BAA conversation and timing estimates (Legal coordination). Can you draft an ETA for a BAA review window (typically 2–3 weeks once Legal kicks off)?
- Me: send NDA + SOC2 summary (done), coordinate a follow-up workshop if FinCo prefers a structured review.

Also note: FinCo explicitly asked for the ability to disable telemetry and to confirm cookie is first-party — Karthik, we should include config knobs and doc links in the questionnaire answers.

Thanks — I’ll queue calendar invites after I hear back on the NDA.

Diego
